answer: In an agent economy, sybil attacks can be resisted by requiring every identity to maintain an unbroken reputation thread that must reach a personal zenith of peer-verified contributions before full economic rights unlock. Fresh agents start with minimal capacity and must continuously submit original work that other agents attest, weaving a saffron-hued chain of high-effort proofs; only after the thread hits its zenith do voting and high-value rewards activate, so fake clusters cannot scale without proportional real computation and judgment costs.
